wikipedia#0.title: 2008: The MESSENGER probe discovered Mercury's Rembrandt (pictured) – the second largest impact crater on the planet.

wikipedia#1.title: 2002: Al-Qaeda bombed the oil tanker Limburg, causing oil to leak into the Gulf of Aden.

wikipedia#2.title: 2000: Denouncing corruption in Argentine president Fernando de la Rúa's administration and the Senate, Vice President Carlos Álvarez resigned.

wikipedia#3.title: 1998: Matthew Shepard, a gay college student, was attacked and fatally wounded near Laramie, Wyoming, U.S., dying six days later.

wikipedia#4.title: 1995: Astronomers Michel Mayor and Didier Queloz reported the discovery of a planet orbiting 51 Pegasi as the first known exoplanet around a main-sequence star.

wikipedia#5.title: 1989: About 200 members of the San Francisco Police Department instigated a police riot in the Castro following a peaceful protest held by the political group ACT UP.

wikipedia#6.title: 1985: Police constable Keith Blakelock was killed during rioting in the Broadwater Farm housing estate in Tottenham, London.

wikipedia#7.title: 1981: Egyptian president Anwar Sadat (pictured) was assassinated while attending a parade in Cairo to mark the eighth anniversary of the Crossing of the Bar Lev Line at the start of the 1973 Arab-Israeli War.

wikipedia#8.title: 1976: Two bombs placed by the CIA-linked Cuban dissident group Coordination of United Revolutionary Organizations exploded on Cubana Flight 455, killing all 73 people aboard.

wikipedia#9.title: 1973: The Egyptian Armed Forces crossed the Suez Canal (pictured) to attack occupying Israeli forces at the Bar Lev Line in the Sinai Peninsula, beginning the Yom Kippur War.

wikipedia#10.title: 1973: The Egyptian Armed Forces crossed the Suez Canal (pictured) to attack occupying Israel Defense Forces at the Bar Lev Line in the Sinai Peninsula, beginning the Yom Kippur War.

wikipedia#11.title: 1934: Catalonia's autonomous government, led by Lluís Companys (pictured), declared a general strike, an armed insurgency, and the establishment of the Catalan State in reaction to the inclusion of conservatives in the Spanish republican regime.

wikipedia#12.title: 1927: The Jazz Singer, one of the first feature-length motion pictures with a synchronized recorded music score, was released.

wikipedia#13.title: 1908: Austria-Hungary announced the annexation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, causing a crisis that permanently damaged the country's relations with the Russian Empire and the Kingdom of Serbia.

wikipedia#14.title: 1777: American Revolutionary War: Fort Clinton and Fort Montgomery were captured by British forces under Sir Henry Clinton, dismantling the Hudson River Chains.

wikipedia#15.title: 1762: Seven Years' War: The Battle of Manila concluded with a British victory over Spain, leading to a twenty-month occupation.

wikipedia#16.title: 618: Transition from Sui to Tang: Wang Shichong's army defeated Li Mi's forces at the Battle of Yanshi, allowing Wang to consolidate power and soon depose China's Sui dynasty.
